question: What is the total sales amount per category?
answer: Beverages led with the highest total sales at about 267,868.18, followed by Dairy Products at about 234,507.28. Grains/Cereals had the lowest sales at about 95,744.59.
sql: SELECT c.category_name, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_sales FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_details AS od ON p.product_id = od.product_id GROUP BY c.category_name LIMIT 1001
explanation: Calculates total sales revenue for each product category using order line details and discounts.

sources.description: Our food trading business (customers, orders, products, suppliers, shippers).
